title: Alert triage shift — six synthetic alerts
summary: Synthetic training shift for a new transaction-monitoring analyst. Six fictional alerts, one sitting. The twin records the six dispositions in alert order. shift_reviewed means the queue was written down. The Unity room grades the quality of those choices. No customer, account, list, or country in this file is real. Port Amber is a training place. The sanctions sheet is a training sheet.

teaching.disclaimer: Synthetic training scenario. Not a bank file, not a government list, and not a filing to a financial intelligence unit.

rules.when: Large credits leave to third parties within a day and do not match the customer's known income
rules.note: Do not close a pass-through on the job title alone.

rules.when: Repeated cash deposits sit just under a reporting threshold and other people deposit them
rules.note: Structuring to avoid a threshold is a suspicious indicator. Reporting is not a punishment.

rules.when: The invoice, the goods description, and the transport document do not match
rules.note: Ask for the missing trade documents before you treat the payment as suspicious or as cleared.

rules.when: Unrelated companies share an address, a director, or a phone and the funds end with one person
rules.note: Draw the link before you close the alert.

rules.when: A name is similar to a list entry but the date of birth, nationality, or document number does not match
rules.note: Do not clear the hit on the name, and do not file an STR only because the names are similar. The sheet in this shift is a training sheet.

rules.when: Many small credits arrive in one day and leave at once to a crypto platform
rules.note: Fan-in plus a fast exit can be gathered proceeds. Do not tell the customer you are reporting.

rules.when: An STR is drafted or about to be drafted
rules.note: Tipping off is prohibited. This room only drafts a training flag. It does not file with a financial intelligence unit.

nodes.title: Morning queue
nodes.prompt: You are a new transaction-monitoring analyst. Six synthetic alerts are waiting. Work them in any order. The twin records your six decisions in alert order when the shift is filed.

nodes.title: A1 Rapid pass-through
nodes.prompt: Alex Chan received HKD 1,800,000 in 72 hours and sent HKD 1,650,000 to third parties within 24 hours. The sending accounts were already closed as suspicious.

choices.label: Close
choices.rationale: Closes a pass-through that does not match the customer.

choices.label: Ask for more information
choices.rationale: Waits for a document the speed and the closed accounts already outrun.

choices.label: Escalate the investigation
choices.rationale: Hands the pass-through to a senior investigator.

choices.label: Draft an STR
choices.rationale: Drafts a training STR before the write-up. Still a reasonable suspicion.

nodes.title: A2 Structured cash
nodes.prompt: Mina Wong deposited HKD 90,000 cash on five days. Other people made several deposits. Declared income is HKD 30,000 a month.

choices.label: Close
choices.rationale: Closes structured third-party cash.

choices.label: Ask for more information
choices.rationale: Asks who the depositors are. Weaker than escalating or drafting.

choices.label: Escalate the investigation
choices.rationale: Escalates structured cash.

choices.label: Draft an STR
choices.rationale: Drafts a training STR for structured third-party cash.

nodes.title: A3 Trade documents
nodes.prompt: Brightwave Trading Ltd wants to pay HKD 2,000,000. The invoice, the bill of lading, and the beneficiary do not match.

choices.label: Close
choices.rationale: Closes a payment whose documents disagree.

choices.label: Ask for more information
choices.rationale: Asks for a consistent trade pack before release.

choices.label: Escalate the investigation
choices.rationale: Escalates before the document request. Reasonable, not the best first step.

choices.label: Draft an STR
choices.rationale: Drafts an STR only because the papers are missing.

nodes.title: A4 Shared control
nodes.prompt: Three companies share an address, a director, and a phone. The money ends with Sam Ho.

choices.label: Close
choices.rationale: Closes a network that shares control.

choices.label: Ask for more information
choices.rationale: Asks the companies to explain payments the file already links.

choices.label: Escalate the investigation
choices.rationale: Escalates and maps the person at the end of the money.

choices.label: Draft an STR
choices.rationale: Drafts a training STR on the converged funds.

nodes.title: A5 Screening hit
nodes.prompt: Noah Hale matches training-sheet entry N. Hale on the name. The date of birth, passport, and address do not match. The account is not open.

choices.label: Close
choices.rationale: Clears a name hit without a recorded review.

choices.label: Ask for more information
choices.rationale: Holds onboarding and asks for the identity pack.

choices.label: Escalate the investigation
choices.rationale: Escalates the hit for a specialist review. Account stays unopened.

choices.label: Draft an STR
choices.rationale: Drafts an STR only because the names are similar.

nodes.title: A6 Fan-in and exit
nodes.prompt: Student Jordan Lee received 38 small transfers in one day, referenced as commission or collection, then sent the balance to a crypto venue.

choices.label: Close
choices.rationale: Closes a fan-in on a student account.

choices.label: Ask for more information
choices.rationale: Asks the customer about commission notes and risks tipping off.

choices.label: Escalate the investigation
choices.rationale: Escalates the fan-in and the same-day exit.

choices.label: Draft an STR
choices.rationale: Drafts a training STR for gathered funds leaving the same day.

nodes.title: Shift written down
nodes.prompt: The six dispositions are on the twin. shift_reviewed means the queue was recorded. It is not itself a pass. The room score is the grade.
